pkgmetadata.longdescription: Talkies is a local-first dictation app: hold a hotkey, speak, and the transcript (Whisper, optionally cleaned up by a local LLM) is typed into the focused window. Recording, inference and text insertion run on-device. app-accessibility/talkies builds from source; app-accessibility/talkies-bin installs the prebuilt release.

use.flag: Build Talkies and ggml for this machine's CPU (-Dcpu=native, GGML_NATIVE) instead of the portable x86-64-v2 / AVX2 baseline
Pull in gui-apps/wl-clipboard for pasting on Wayland
Pull in x11-misc/xclip for pasting on X11
